expectations.text: Presents the ownership-labels outcome as a complete decision, not a placeholder or deferral
expectations.evidence: The charter says outright: "Under the skill, ownership labels only is a complete outcome, not a deferral." Its decision line is "Decision: ownership labels only." The outcome is fully built out: three labels with buyer meaning, a listing bar, support routing with listing sentences, a renewal floor, a decertification ladder, agreement clauses, KPIs and a dated rollout plan. It also says "There is no earned quality label. Ownership is the only discriminator buyers need today." Two things weaken this slightly.
